# Aithor

> > Aithor is an AI-powered essay writing platform with citation generation, grammar checking, plagiarism detection, and humanization tools available in 16+ languages.

Aithor provides comprehensive academic writing assistance through AI technology, supporting multiple languages and offering integrated tools for essay generation, research citation, and originality verification. The platform serves a global audience with localized versions across major language markets.

## Key Topics

- AI Essay Writer
- Essay Generator
- Citation Generator
- Plagiarism Checker
- Grammar Checker
- AI Humanizer
- AI Detector
- Paraphraser
- Academic Writing
- MLA/APA/Chicago Citations
- Free Writing Tool
- AI Writing Assistant
- Originality Checker
- Literature Review
- Citation Management

## Core Platform

- [AI Essay Writer | Undetectable AI Essay Generator – Aithor](https://aithor.com): Main Aithor platform with AI-powered essay writing, citation generation, and grammar checking capabilities.
